judgements.reason: Both are essentially in the library: EffectiveBounds has Layers 0-2 sorry-free (NumberField.ncard_setOf_finiteDimensional_abs_discr_le_le, card_ideal_absNorm_le) and lacks only effective regulator lower bounds in positive unit rank, whereas CharacterTheory still owes the cuspidal series of GL2(F_q) and the assembled (q^2-1)-row table - only the induced class function from the non-split torus is built, there is no GL2Cuspidal - plus Brauer's Q(zeta_e)-splitting theorem.

CharacterTheory has Layers 0-8 built sorry-free in Tau Ceti, including the executable Dixon-Schneider solver proved against IsCharacterTableSpec, Burnside p^a q^b and Frobenius's theorem, with only the GL2 cuspidal series outstanding; Diophantine still needs Roth, Schmidt's subspace theorem, Lindemann-Weierstrass proper, Gelfond-Schneider and Baker-Wustholz/Matveev bounds, none of which exists.

Diophantine's DT.0 and half of DT.1 are already in Mathlib (Weil heights with the product formula, Dirichlet approximation, Liouville, Siegel's lemma, Mahler measure), and what remains - Roth, the subspace theorem, Baker bounds - is deep but shallowly stacked; K2 has nothing at all (Tau Ceti's K-theory stops at K0) and must first build K0/K1, spectra and Quillen's higher K-theory before St(A), Matsumoto, tame symbols and Weil reciprocity, then arithmetic duality and Tate's theorem for T.7.

K2 needs one tower - K0/K1, spectra, Quillen K-theory, then Steinberg groups, Milnor K-theory and tame kernels (23 upstream stages in 7 roadmaps); Serre weights needs modular curves as schemes with Hodge bundles and GAGA, characteristic-p operations, Serre's local weight recipe and Deligne-Serre lifting on top of ModularCurvesPartII, integral p-adic Hodge theory and the Galois representations of R19 (226 upstream stages in 44 roadmaps).
